annotations.title: Geocode an address, coordinates: place or address name to latitude and longitude

description: Geocode a place or address to latitude and longitude: a city, town, landmark or address name becomes coordinates, with country, region, population and elevation where known, best match first (Wikidata, CC0). Use to turn a place name into coordinates for maps, distance, weather or routing. Example: name=Uppsala. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: geocode_address
